lines.beaver: 안녕하세요. 이번 달 지출을 정리해 보셨어요?
lines.beaver_en: Hello. Have you sorted out this month's spending?
lines.beaver_roman: annyeonghaseyo. ibeon dal jichureul jeongnihae bosyeosseoyo?
lines.en: Yes, housing costs are my biggest expense.

lines.learner: 월세로 매달 육십만 원 정도 나가요.
lines.en: About 600,000 won goes to rent every month.
lines.roman: wolsero maedal yuksimman won jeongdo nagayo.

lines.learner: 외식을 자주 해서 외식비가 많이 나와요.
lines.en: I eat out often, so dining-out costs are high.
lines.roman: oesigeul jaju haeseo oesikppiga mani nawayo.

lines.beaver_en: Have you thought about ways to cut your spending?
lines.learner: 알뜰한 소비를 생활화하려고 선불 카드를 써요.
lines.en: I use a prepaid card to make frugal spending a habit.
lines.roman: altteulhan sobireul saenghwalhwaharyeogo seonbul kadeureul sseoyo.

lines.en: The insurance premium is paid automatically every month.

lines.beaver_en: Are you saving emergency money separately?
lines.learner: 네, 매달 십만 원씩 비상금으로 모아요.
lines.en: Yes, I save 100,000 won a month as emergency money.
lines.roman: ne, maedal simman wonssik bisanggeumeuro moayo.

lines.beaver_en: Are there any other big expenses?
lines.en: There's also money I send to my parents every month.

lines.learner: 아니요, 인출기 수수료 때문에 잘 안 써요.
lines.en: No, I rarely do because of ATM fees.
lines.roman: aniyo, inchulgi susuryo ttaemune jal an sseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: How do you usually manage your money?
lines.en: I check my spending in real time on an app.

lines.beaver: 좋습니다. 다음 달엔 외식비부터 줄여 봅시다.
lines.beaver_en: Good. Next month, let's start by cutting dining out.
lines.beaver_roman: jotseumnida. daeum daren oesikppibuteo juryeo bopsida.
lines.learner: 네, 실속 있게 씀씀이를 줄여 볼게요. 감사합니다.
lines.en: Okay, I'll cut my spending wisely. Thank you.
lines.roman: ne, silsok itkke sseumsseumireul juryeo bolgeyo. gamsahamnida.
